segments.context: Verve Coffee Roasters · United StatesHoliday Blend (2026 seasonal whole bean)Verve's 2026 Holiday Blend is a focused seasonal trial for a buyer who wants a light, fruit-accented filter cup and may also make espresso. Its current record names washed Guatemala Antigua and natural Ethiopia Guji, with a 25:375 Dwell start. Fellow independently tasted a current sample and published separate pour-over and espresso recipes. Orange zest, candied chestnut and pine are attributed tasting words, not Coffeedant results. Buy a dated 12 oz whole-bean bag first; neither an earlier Holiday Blend nor a bulk size proves this season's cup will suit you.Updated 2026-11-12 · Check current US Holiday Blend whole-bean checkout total at November 12, 2026
